listing.name: asteroid ship pack
listing.summary: Provides improved collision models for this ship pack.
listing.aiSummary: Provides improved collision models for this ship pack.

description: Offers a patch containing updated .ship files for the asteroid ship pack. These files add more points to adhere accurately to uneven surfaces, improving collisions especially on larger ships at the cost of performance, and reduce some collision radii.
